body: Measured: copying 10 docs-only commits took about 10 h, mostly per-commit gates and serial reviews; verify takes 17 min; a Joust probe took 53 min. A-D and G are shared, so VectorCraft builds them first.
summary: Speed-up proposal: (A) gate scaled to the change, (B) review per branch, (C) a tip-SHA gate stamp, (D) a machine-wide MAME/cargo slot cap, (G) per-area spec challenge and ask-the-owner-first; ours: parallel cached verify, per-game mechanics files, parallel probes, 2h check-ins
